prerequisites.name: Redfish resource tree (Systems, Chassis, Managers)
prerequisites.definition: The hierarchical layout of Redfish resources describing servers, enclosures and management controllers.

prerequisites.name: Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)
prerequisites.definition: An embedded controller that manages and monitors a server independently of its OS.
